summary: The guideline on a one-year renewal for {apartment} changes halfway through the term.
realLife: New York City's 2021 apartment order allowed no guideline increase for the first six months of a covered one-year lease and allowed 1.5 percent for the rest.
gates: The case record identifies the governing order, term and lease start date.
inGame: needs: governing order, term and lease start date.

turns.what: The guideline leaves the starting rent alone.
turns.pulledBy: The tenant is in the first six months
The lease enters its seventh month
